EvalConfig.description:
The versions an evaluation ran against: the same keys a Request carries.

The contract test asserts that every field here exists on Request with the same type,
so an eval run and a production request are always comparable.

embedding_model_id.description: Embedding model as provider/name@version:dims. The model is the namespace of every vector it produced; two models never share an index.
embedding_model_id.title: Embedding Model Id

llm_id.description: A model reference as provider/name@version (LLMs, rerankers, judges).
llm_id.title: Llm Id

prompt_template_version.description: A version tag: letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash; 1-64 characters.
prompt_template_version.title: Prompt Template Version

anyOf.description: A model reference as provider/name@version (LLMs, rerankers, judges).

retrieval_config_version.description: A version tag: letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash; 1-64 characters.
retrieval_config_version.title: Retrieval Config Version

EvalConfig.title: EvalConfig

LlmParams.description: Generation parameters; part of the lineage of every answer.

seed.description: Set when the provider honours seeds.
seed.title: Seed

LlmParams.title: LlmParams

baseline_run_id.description: The run this one is compared against.
baseline_run_id.title: Baseline Run Id

cost_usd.description: Cost in USD at the price in force when the row was written.
cost_usd.title: Cost Usd

created_at.description: When this row was written (UTC, timezone-aware). Freshness is computed from it.
created_at.title: Created At

eval_set_version.description: Version of the golden set; sets are immutable.
eval_set_version.title: Eval Set Version

schema_version.description: Version of this row's schema. Bumped on any field change; see CONTRIBUTING.md.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the row. Every index query and cost report filters on it.
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

tokens_in.description: Input tokens charged for this row.
tokens_in.title: Tokens In

tokens_out.description: Output tokens charged for this row.
tokens_out.title: Tokens Out
